# CallLint

> Evidence-backed verdicts for agent tools.
> Scan MCP servers before your agent runs them.

CallLint is a CLI-first, IDE-friendly, JSON-native security verdict engine for
MCP servers and agent skills.

## Current Release

The current stable release is 1.8.0 on the `latest` tag.

## Lookup-First Approach

Before running a full scan, check if trust pages already exist:

- Trust Page Lookup: `https://calllint.com/trust/{publisher}/{server-name}/`
- Lookup API: `https://calllint.com/trust/lookup`
- Well-known Discovery: `https://calllint.com/.well-known/calllint.json`
- MCP Search Tool: `calllint_search_agent_tools`

Run a fresh scan when your config/artifact differs or observations are stale.

## What is CallLint?

CallLint performs deterministic static preflight inspection of MCP server
configurations and agent tool authority surfaces. It returns SAFE, REVIEW,
BLOCK, or UNKNOWN verdicts with evidence before execution — never executes
the server it judges.

## Official MCP Registry

CallLint is published to the Official MCP Registry:
- Registry: io.github.calllint/calllint
- Package: calllint-mcp
- State: LIVE
- Version: 0.2.0
- Registry URL: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=calllint

## Agent Harnesses CallLint Tracks

CallLint tracks 18 agent harnesses: 13 with native auto-discovery (`--agent <id>`), 5 documented only, with no detection yet.

The P0/P1/P2-P3 tiers below order hosts by how commonly they are used. They are NOT a
capability claim: read each host's own command or support class.

**P0 (Most Common):**
- Claude Code (Anthropic) — calllint scan --agent claude-code
- Claude Desktop (Anthropic) — calllint scan --agent claude-desktop
- Cursor (Anysphere) — calllint scan --agent cursor
- WorkBuddy (Tencent Cloud) — calllint scan --agent workbuddy

**P1 (Additional Major):**
- VS Code (Microsoft) — calllint scan --agent vscode
- Windsurf (Codeium) — calllint scan --agent windsurf
- Qwen Code (Alibaba Cloud) — calllint scan --agent qwen-code

**P2-P3 (Less Common):**
- OpenClaw (Open Source) — calllint scan --agent openclaw
- OpenAI Codex (OpenAI) — calllint scan --agent codex
- GitHub Copilot CLI (GitHub) — no scan command yet (Guide only) — https://calllint.com/harnesses/copilot-cli
- Cline (Open Source) — calllint scan --agent cline
- Gemini CLI (Google) — calllint scan --agent gemini-cli
- CodeBuddy (Tencent) — no scan command yet (Guide only) — https://calllint.com/harnesses/codebuddy
- OpenCode (Open Source) — calllint scan --agent opencode
- Kiro (AWS) — calllint scan --agent kiro
- Continue (Continue) — no scan command yet (Guide only) — https://calllint.com/harnesses/continue
- Roo Code (Roo Code Inc) — no scan command yet (Guide only) — https://calllint.com/harnesses/roo-code
- DeepSeek Harness (DeepSeek) — no scan command yet (Guide only) — https://calllint.com/harnesses/deepseek-harness

## Installation

npm install -g calllint

## Basic Usage

# Auto-detect agent configuration (no install required)
npx calllint scan --auto

# Non-interactive / CI form
npx calllint scan .cursor/mcp.json --ci --no-emoji

# Run CallLint as an MCP server
npx -y calllint-mcp

# Write CallLint into an agent host's config
npx calllint integrate

# Scan specific agent
calllint scan --agent claude-code

# Scan a specific MCP config file (the target is positional)
calllint scan ~/.claude/settings.json

# JSON output
calllint scan --auto --json

## Key Features

- Deterministic static analysis (no server execution)
- Evidence-backed verdicts (SAFE, REVIEW, BLOCK, UNKNOWN)
- Agency Risk Model (Agency × Authority × Data Sensitivity × Side Effect × Observability × Reproducibility)
- Policy-as-code support
- IDE and terminal friendly
